answer: Each epoch a public beacon posts a 32-byte nonce at a jittered second; the agent has 90 seconds to climb a three-rung trellis (preimage, signed nonce, live reply) that three graders check. Transcripts cannot be reused. A difficulty delta adds 3 extra 64MB memory-hard passes per sibling sharing a funder (base: 1 pass). Ten socks each do 28 passes; a thousand each do 2,998, or 2,998× a singleton. Fresh wallets dodge the delta, so graders fuse identities whose live replies land within 80ms more than twice in four epochs and then apply that same delta.
